for.en: Drivers and riders: priced on how much and how you really drive; covers hitting someone, damage to your vehicle and theft
for.zh: 開車騎車的人：依你實際開多少、怎麼開來算保費；保你撞到別人、車子受損和被偷

options.en: A scooter or moped (50cc to 250cc, or electric)
options.zh: 速克達或輕型機車（50–250cc 或電動）

questions.en: What is it worth now, roughly?

questions.zh: 平常停在哪裡？（郵遞區號）

questions.en: Years since you got your license?
At-fault accidents in the last three years?
questions.zh: 過去三年有幾次是你的責任的事故？

questions.en: About how many miles a month?
Let Cover's app record your trips to price your cover? (no locations: only distance, hard braking, speeding and late-night driving counts)
questions.zh: 願意讓 Cover 的 App 記錄行程來算保費嗎？（不記錄位置，只記里程、急煞、超速和深夜行駛次數）

options.en: Liability, theft and collision (your own vehicle)
options.zh: 第三人責任＋竊盜＋自己的車損

coverages.en: Liability (injuring someone, damaging their vehicle or property)
coverages.zh: 第三人責任（撞傷人、撞壞別人的車或財物）

coverages.en: Collision and other damage to your vehicle (scrapes, vandalism, storms, flood)
coverages.zh: 自己的車碰撞與其他損壞（刮傷、惡意破壞、風災、淹水）

addons.en: Roadside help (a 20-mile tow, fuel, a tire change, a jump start)
addons.zh: 道路救援（拖吊 20 英里、送油、換胎、接電）

claims.en: Scraped, dented or vandalized while parked (unknown who)
claims.zh: 停車時被刮、被撞或被破壞（不知道是誰）
我撞到東西或發生碰撞

claims.en: I damaged someone else's vehicle or property
claims.zh: 我撞壞別人的車或財物

clauses.en: The "insured vehicle" is the one with the VIN on the policy. A "driver" is anyone with a valid license using it with your permission.
clauses.zh: 「承保車輛」指保單所載車身號碼（VIN）之車輛。「駕駛人」指經你允許使用承保車輛、持有有效駕照之人。

clauses.en: The "driving score" (0 to 100) comes from trip records: points off per 100 miles for hard braking, hard acceleration, speeding and driving between midnight and 4 am. It updates monthly and next month's premium moves with it, down by up to 20% or up by up to 25%.
clauses.zh: 「駕駛分數」由行程紀錄計算（0–100），依每 100 英里的急煞、急加速、超速及凌晨 0–4 時行駛次數扣分。分數每月更新，下個月保費依此調整，最多調降 20%、調升 25%。

clauses.en: When a driver of the insured vehicle is legally liable for someone else's injury, death or property damage in an accident, we pay and defend you, up to $300,000 per accident, which meets or exceeds every state's minimum liability limits.
clauses.zh: 駕駛人使用承保車輛，因意外致他人受傷、死亡或財物損失，依法應負賠償責任時，我們代為賠償並為你抗辯，每一事故最高 30 萬美元，高於各州法定最低責任保額。

clauses.en: If the insured vehicle is stolen and not recovered within 30 days of the police report, we pay its actual cash value less a 10% deductible. If it is recovered damaged, CR-2.3 applies.
clauses.zh: 承保車輛失竊，自報案日起 30 日內未尋回者，我們依車輛實際現值扣除 10% 自負額理賠。尋回時有損壞者，依 CR-2.3 處理。

clauses.en: When the insured vehicle is damaged by a collision, rolling over, scrapes, vandalism, a storm, hail or flood, we pay the repair less a $500 deductible, up to its actual cash value. A repair over 75% of the value counts as a total loss, paid at value.
clauses.zh: 承保車輛因碰撞、翻覆、刮損、惡意破壞、風災、冰雹或淹水而受損，我們支付修理費用扣除 500 美元自負額，以車輛實際現值為上限。修理費超過現值 75% 者，視為全損，依現值理賠。

clauses.en: No payment when driving over the legal blood alcohol limit (0.08%, or any amount under 21), on drugs, without a valid license, or after leaving the scene; we still pay the injured party first, then recover it from the driver.
clauses.zh: 酒駕（血液酒精濃度 0.08% 以上，未滿 21 歲者任何濃度）、吸毒、無照或駕照失效時駕駛，或肇事逃逸，不予理賠；但受害人的損害我們仍先行賠付，再向駕駛人求償。

clauses.en: No payment for racing, carrying passengers or goods for pay (rideshare and delivery apps included, unless endorsed), damage on purpose, or wear of tires and parts.
clauses.zh: 競速、營業載客載貨（含共乘與外送平台，除非另行批註）、故意行為，以及輪胎、零件的自然耗損，不予理賠。

clauses.en: No payment for theft while the vehicle was unlocked with the key or fob left in it.
clauses.zh: 未上鎖且鑰匙或遙控器留在車上時的失竊，不予理賠。

clauses.en: After an accident, call the police when anyone is hurt or the other party disputes it, and tell us at once; we need the police report number. For a single-vehicle accident, give photos of the scene.
clauses.zh: 發生事故後，有人受傷或對方有爭議時應報警，並立即通知我們；我們需要警方報告編號。單一車輛事故請提供現場照片。

clauses.en: Get a repair estimate and our agreement before repairs, except an urgent tow.
clauses.zh: 修理前應先提供估價單，經我們同意後再修理；緊急拖吊不在此限。

clauses.en: False information, faked trip records, or an undeclared main driver lets us deny the claim and cancel the policy.
clauses.zh: 提供不實資料、偽造行程紀錄或未申報之主要駕駛人使用者，我們得拒絕理賠並終止保單。

clauses.en: Roadside help: 4 times a year, a free tow up to 20 miles, fuel, a spare tire fitted, a jump start.
clauses.zh: 道路救援：每年 4 次，拖吊 20 英里內免費、送油、換備胎、接電。

clauses.en: Paid monthly; with trip records, adjusted each month by the driving score. A failed payment has 14 days' grace, then lapses until paid. Cancel any time for a refund of the days left. 20% of the premium is Cover's flat fee, the rest the claims pool; what is left after the year goes to your chosen cause.
clauses.zh: 保費月繳，啟用行程紀錄者每月依駕駛分數調整。扣款失敗有 14 日寬限期，逾期停效，補繳後復效。可隨時退保，按未經過日數退費。保費的 20% 為 Cover 的固定費用，其餘進入理賠池；年度結算後剩餘捐給你選的公益團體。
